preconditions.expression: isinstance(starting_string, str) and isinstance(n, int) and n >= 1
preconditions.description: The starting_string must be a non-empty string and n must be a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == starting_string if n == 1 else True
postconditions.description: If n is 1, the result must be exactly the starting_string.
The result must be a non-empty string for every valid n.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value == look_and_say_sequence(return_value, n - 1) if n > 1 else True for _ in range(n))
postconditions.description: The result must be the nth element in the look-and-say sequence starting from starting_string, where each subsequent element is generated by the look-and-say operation on the previous one.
